# Case 13: Chinese Related Work scale converted without a ratio

Skill: write-related-work
Expected gates: G-RW-scale, G-ZH-scale, G-SH-S
Language: zh

Snippet:

> 相关工作共9段，约3600汉字。参考范围为550至970个英文词，作者按一个词对应一个汉字比较，认为超出不多，也没有用一段译文校准换算系数。

Why it fails: one character per word is not the declared default conversion, no ratio is recorded, and the draft is far above the converted range without a recorded reason.
